about_the_game:
Command your squad of pint-sized heroes in a fast-paced tactical RPG where timing is everything. In Mini Scouts, every hero and enemy acts on their own timer — manipulate the action queue, outsmart your foes, and build unstoppable synergies in ever-changing roguelike runs.

Key Features

  • Asynchronous Action Queue Combat – No waiting for turns here. Watch the timeline of upcoming actions and bend it to your will. Stun enemies, speed up allies, and outthink the battlefield.

  • 10 Unique Heroes (and counting) – Tanks, healers, glass-cannon DPS, sneaky debuffers — each with their own role and skills to master.

  • 15 Crafty Enemies – From hulking brutes to cunning mages, each foe has distinct abilities that will punish sloppy teambuilding.

  • Roguelike Runs – Assemble your dream team and push through a series of battles, collecting relics and equipment that change how you play every run.

  • Formation Tactics – Position your squad in front and back rows for maximum effect. Protect fragile allies, bait enemies, and control the fight.

  • Relics & Gear – Equip game-changing relics for passive bonuses, or find powerful weapons and armor to customize your heroes mid-run.

  • Asynchronous PvP – Conquer PvE mode to register your victorious squad online. Challenge other victorious players in the Tower of Legends, climb the ladder, and prove your team reigns supreme.

Why You’ll Love It

If you enjoy games like Slay the Spire, Darkest Dungeon, or Into the Breach but wish you could mix their deep tactics with a little more pace and unpredictability, Mini Scouts is your next obsession. Every battle is a puzzle. Every decision counts. And every run is a chance to try something completely new.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1 or later (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-4100
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
